description: Pays for a plan or product as a test member through the app's real checkout in Stripe's sandbox (test mode), to prove what the app does after a payment. outcome names what to prove: pays (a paid purchase), declined (Stripe declines it; nothing is granted) or asks_to_verify (Stripe asks the payer to verify, then it pays). Gemmein pays with Stripe's own published sandbox numbers for that outcome — nothing real is charged, and no payment details are ever typed into or sent through this chat. Sandbox keys only, test members only, the test kit's daily caps. When this server can't complete Stripe's sandbox page itself, the answer is the sandbox checkout link for your human to finish in their browser; test_outcome then reads the result. This is what a founder may call trying a payment.
name: test_pay
title: Test a payment
